result.title: RE-SciVQA: Improving Scientific VQA With Context-Relevant Retrieval and Lightweight MLLM Adaptation
result.summary: A deep understanding of scientific literature often relies on interpreting figures that contain key information beyond the main text. Leveraging Large Language Models (LLMs) to extract insights from these figures can significantly accelerate knowledge discovery. Existing works on Scientific Visual Question Answering rely on resource-intensive training pipelines that are often inaccessible and require large computational resources. Instead of designing complex architectures, we propose RE- SciVQA, which focuses on improving the quality of retrieved context and fine-tuning small LLMs with parameter-efficient LoRA training. Using a simple query expansion step, relevant section headers are appended to the original question to improve the retrieval coverage. In addition, a simple adjustment of similarity scores is applied using figure references and caption alignment. On the SciVQA benchmark, RE-SciVQA achieves a ROUGE-1 F1 score of 73.9%, outperforming chart-focused models such as UniChart (14.7%), ChartGemma (6.9%), and Matcha-ChartQA (6.3%). Our relevance-enhanced RAG setup also improves the exact match by 11.9% and the fuzzy match by 29.5% compared with a standard RAG baseline, resulting in an overall gain of 14.3%. We also examine closed-ended infinite visual questions, a category in which chart-understanding models often struggle. Our experiments show that using plot digitization instead of synthetic captions leads to an 18.5% improvement for this question type.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 RE-SciVQA，通过查询扩展（把相关章节标题附到问题后）以及基于图引用与标题对齐的相似度分数调整来改进检索上下文质量，并用 LoRA 轻量微调小模型，在 SciVQA 上报告 ROUGE 与匹配率提升，另比较了图数字化与合成标题对封闭式问题的影响。
AI.relevance_reason: 与 latent visual reasoning 主线无直接关系，但其检索打分重排与图引用对齐可视为一种外部证据筛选方式，可能可供核查「哪些视觉/图文证据被带入推理」这一问题的启发线索。
